quarterly_data.signal: First hardware detail on the MemoryAI KV cache appliance: it uses Penguin-developed CXL memory expansion cards that are 1 terabyte each, and a whole set of those cards placed into one server appliance adds 11 terabytes of ultra-high performance memory-based storage that serves pre-computed tokens over a low latency network to a host of inference servers. Penguin's solution is 100% based on the fastest DDR5 memory rather than flash-based KV caching approaches, which management described as much, much slower - 100 times slower - the point being the lowest time to first token and offloading work that would otherwise go back to the GPUs.
quarterly_data.figure: CXL cards 1 terabyte each; appliance adds 11 terabytes; DDR5 vs flash 100 times slower

quarterly_data.signal: Scale of the ClusterWareAI operating base and silicon-agnostic reach: Penguin has accumulated over 4 billion hours of runtime experience managing GPU clusters at scale, has been an NVIDIA DGX-ready managed services partner and was an initial inductee into NVIDIA's new AI factory specialized partner program. OriginAI validated blueprints exist for NVIDIA training architectures, for AMD-based training architectures and for inference solutions, and the Spectra system delivered to Sandia National Laboratories was based on a Kneron silicon advanced accelerator - an example of Penguin deploying silicon beyond NVIDIA and AMD.
quarterly_data.figure: over 4 billion hours of runtime experience of managing GPU clusters at scale

quarterly_data.signal: On the SK relationships: SK Telecom is an investor in Penguin Solutions, but management said the collaboration transcends that investment and came about through business collaboration and a synergistic ability to go to market together. The Haein cluster Penguin designed and deployed is award-winning for its rapid deployment time and uptime, is ClusterWare-managed, is operated today by Penguin's services team with people in the data center in Korea, and is consumed on a 100% sovereign Neo Cloud basis with all network traffic required to stay within South Korea. Management pointed to SK Telecom's announced intent to expand meaningfully across APAC as further opportunity, and separately described SK hynix as a company with whom Penguin has had a long-term relationship and partnership on the memory side of the business.

Software monetization and channel model: ClusterWareAI is licensed on a subscription basis so cost stays tied to the value the customer obtains over time, and it typically runs alongside Penguin's managed-services agreements. Beyond Dell, where Penguin was named a Dell AI Partner of the Year this summer, management named partnerships with CDW and WWT; in the CDW case Penguin can leverage CDW's in-place supply chain relationships with enterprises so the customer procures through a single source while Penguin becomes the fulfillment arm and the long-term manager of the system.
